# Requirements: Customer Notification System

## Overview
The Customer Notification System keeps customers informed of order status changes via email and SMS, and lets them manage which channels they receive notifications on.

## Functional Requirements
FR-01: System sends email notifications to customers for order status changes.
FR-02: System sends SMS notifications to customers for order status changes, if opted in.
FR-03: Customers can view and update their notification channel preferences (email/SMS) via a UI.

## Non-Functional Considerations
Notification delivery must maintain 99.9% uptime, since delayed order-status notifications directly affect customer trust during checkout disputes.

## Existing System Integration
The notification service will publish delivery events to the existing Snowflake data warehouse for reporting, and will call the group's existing SMS Gateway service for outbound SMS delivery.
